statement: To incorporate a company, a person must submit to the Registrar the constitution of the proposed company and the other prescribed documents, furnish the last day of the proposed company's first financial year and the other prescribed information, lodge a notice of the situation of the registered office, and pay the prescribed fee; a registered qualified individual engaged in the formation, or a person named in the constitution as a director or the secretary, must declare that the registration requirements are complied with and that identities were verified, and on registering the constitution the Registrar issues a notice of incorporation stating the date of incorporation and whether the company is limited by shares, limited by guarantee or unlimited, and where applicable that it is private.
caveat: Section 19 carries Act 24 of 2025 amendments in force from 20 October 2026 (the first-financial-year particulars and the registered-office notice move into the application). Registration runs through ACRA's Bizfile portal with a name reservation first; confirm the current filing requirements and fees there before incorporating.
